families.label: Enterprise Outsourcing Services
families.definition: Contracted operation of repeatable business processes, staffing systems, and integrated multi-service functions on behalf of other organizations.

capabilities.label: Business process outsourcing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to assume and operate defined administrative, transactional, customer, finance, human-resource, or other business processes for a client.

capabilities.label: Workforce staffing services
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to recruit, employ or place, schedule, administer, and support temporary, contract, contingent, or direct-hire workers for client organizations.

capabilities.label: Multi-service enterprise outsourcing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to integrate and operate multiple contracted workplace, facility, administrative, technical, or support functions under a unified service model.
